## 简体中文

本次正式版汇总 v2.0.19 之后、v2.0.20-beta.1 至 beta.41 开发周期及后续发布修复，以最终行为合并同类更新。

### DNS、路由与网络接管

- 明确区分前置 DNS 域名分流和 CN 路由分流：前置 DNS 按自定义域名、内置 domains-min、默认策略的顺序选择真实 IP 或 FakeIP；CN 路由按流量的真实目标 IP 生效，不再强制关闭 FakeIP。
- 内置中国大陆域名规则支持启用、直连／代理及核心出口选择；CN 路由支持真实大陆 IP 经物理网卡直连，或进入核心使用指定代理。CN 核心规则只处理 TUN 收到的真实 IP，避免境外域名解析出的国内 CDN 地址覆盖 FakeIP 域名策略。
- 修复自定义域名热更新后 domains-min 丢失的问题。既有 sing-box 自定义域名规则集支持免重启增删、清空和重新添加域名，新连接使用更新后的规则，已有连接保持运行；规则文件发布失败时回滚。
- 新增可配置的内网分流，默认启用并直连，可切换为代理；显式配置的私网隧道规则优先。内网直连支持 sing-box、mihomo 和 clash-rs；内网代理接管支持 sing-box，或 Linux 上的 mihomo。
- 推荐 DNS 配置根据主机路由自动避让 FakeIP 网段冲突，优先使用 `198.18.0.0/15` 中的空闲子网，再按需选择私网备用段；自定义 DNS 配置提供冲突提示及一键填入推荐值。网段变化会提示重启，并保持核心、前置 DNS 和透明代理使用一致的网段。
- 修复 Windows 将自身 TUN 路由误判为 FakeIP 冲突的问题，保留仍有效的已编译网段，避免网段反复切换和重复重启提示；仍会避让真实的外部冲突。
- 修复 macOS 缺少 IPv6 默认路由时无法启用 CN 路由的问题，并补全绑定物理接口的 scoped 默认路由。路由复用、归属及清理检查包含 scope，只清理本服务拥有且身份匹配的路由。
- Windows 改用原生接口、路由与 DNS 查询管理相关网络信息和 CN 路由，并按 IP 地址识别 TUN 接口，减少对命令输出格式和接口名称的依赖。
- 核心出口快捷选择支持搜索直连、可用节点、可路由端点和有效策略组，并核对核心实际选择；统一“直连／代理”文案，区分前置 DNS 直连和核心直连。

### 核心运行与诊断

- 移除自动启动、核心切换、配置应用、导入、热更新及组件部署等流程中的自动核心 check/test、DNS readiness 和静态冲突预检查门禁；保留手动 Validate、实际配置解析和资源归属检查，直接展示核心及系统操作的真实错误。
- DNS 探测失败、预判的端口冲突或网络模式组合不再提前阻止正常核心运行，也不再据此触发旧配置回退；外围实际操作失败单独记录。移除没有实际探测依据的核心 DNS 健康标记，保留前置 DNS 运行状态和错误信息。
- 核心启动、停止及重启的各阶段增加超时上限和可见进度，修复重启后启动任务跟踪不完整的问题，避免界面长期卡在同一步骤。
- 自动启动、手动启动和重启统一记录启动日志；节点调试实时展示核心原始日志。修复从顶栏启动日志查看完整配置时的白屏。
- 新增主机系统路由表，支持基于完整数据的跨页排序。网络诊断增加地址自动完成和常用目标预设，网络测试加入 1.1.1.1 的连通性、HTTP 状态及延迟检查。
- 网络诊断将规则预览与真实请求追踪分开，逐步展示 DNS、TCP、TLS、HTTP 结果及耗时。核心连接证据只在能够唯一关联本次请求时展示；缺少证据或存在歧义时明确保留未知状态，不把规则预测或未捕获到连接误报为实测直连。
- 改善诊断全宽布局、步骤进度、自动跟随及滚动体验，尚未执行的步骤保持中性状态。

### 隧道与 WireGuard

- 隧道配置支持 WS／WSS，新增实例默认 WSS，保留证书校验；保存、重新编辑和切换协议时保留地址及端口，支持连接 OpenWrt WS 服务端。
- 隧道编辑改为按单个实例打开配置弹框，避免一次编辑影响其他实例。
- 修复 WireGuard 隧道绑定未实际生效的问题：配置编译和预览使用所选隧道的本地监听地址，保留原始对端及密钥，解除绑定后恢复原对端。选择隧道时隐藏无需填写的直接 UDP 对端字段，切回直接 UDP 时恢复并校验原输入。
- 无效绑定、无法唯一确定对端或不支持的配置明确报错；停止隧道不静默回退直接 UDP。修复 Windows 本机 wstunnel 回环连接继承核心默认出口网卡绑定、导致 UDP 发送失败的问题。

### 订阅编辑、转换与 OpenWrt

- 规则源支持按出站分组进行图形化编辑，管理分组、名称、URL、类型及格式；重命名时保留顺序、注释和原有字段。配置集节点采用可勾选、全选和拖拽排序的表格，客户端与服务端使用一致交互。
- 内网访问保留结构化表单和 WireGuard 导入，移除整份 JSONC 编辑入口。DNS 重写新增和编辑使用确认／取消弹框，保存失败保留输入；网关配置使用专用弹框，精简多余的页面保存和刷新操作。
- 修复 DNS 和域名分流编辑在页面切换后丢失、旧订阅迁移覆盖设置、无关保存重写原始订阅源，以及简单模式改变当前订阅的问题；简易／完整显示模式保存在实例端。
- 新增 Claude 独立规则和代理分组，提高 Claude、AI 默认规则的优先级；修复 Clash `+.` 域名规则转换时丢失后缀匹配语义的问题。
- 修复 OpenWrt 导出丢失自定义 DNS 上游协议、端口和 TLS 参数的问题，统一目标平台的推荐配置预览与实际导出。OpenWrt sing-box 保持 IPv4-only FakeIP 策略，并添加 BitTorrent 直连规则。
- 统一公开订阅链接格式；链接弹框支持按 Clash、sing-box、Xray、V2Ray、Dae 等格式及 Windows、macOS、OpenWrt、通用平台组合筛选。补充订阅源缓存时长说明，并优化编辑器标签、导航顺序和弹框表现。

### 多用户服务端、代理与资源中继

- 新增托管订阅代理，可导入节点、手动配置或绑定自定义节点。主服务保持无代理核心，托管出口由独立的可选 `sempre-proxy` 服务提供；不会让主服务接管主机 TUN、DNS 或系统代理。
- 已登录用户可查看不含凭据的代理目录并使用、测试代理，只有所有者可读取或修改其配置；代理配置加密存储，引用关系限制误删。代理节点配置编辑保留显式保存／取消操作。
- 订阅 URL 源使用明确选择的代理；未选择时直接连接，不继承环境代理或全局资源出口策略。所选代理不可用时返回错误，不静默回退直连。
- 新增管理员管理的全局资源出口策略，支持默认出口、按主机规则及已保存策略的 URL 测试。规则快照、资源中继、规则转换、大陆 IP／域名列表和 APNIC 备用源统一遵循该策略，与订阅 URL 源的出口选择分开。
- 统一包装导出配置中的远程规则资源 URL，覆盖自定义配置、生成的规则提供者、公开下载和调试输出；支持原始二进制资源转发，保留 sing-box 原生 JSON／`.srs` 格式，避免重复包装。
- 规则、网络列表缓存和订阅产物回退按出口策略及代理版本隔离，避免切换出口后复用旧策略结果。移除资源中继的本地公网 IP 预检查和 DNS 固定，实际请求使用选定出口的网络行为。

### 升级、打包与安全

- 修复部分早期 beta 因迁移校验值变化导致服务启动失败的问题，只接受已核实的等价历史校验值；流量历史保存保留已应用迁移记录。冻结已发布迁移源码，避免后续修改破坏升级历史。
- Windows 服务在完成数据初始化和监听绑定后报告就绪；安装器提交更新前验证 Web 健康，失败时停止新服务并回滚程序和 UI。进一步修复更新与恢复过程中未变化的共享 DNS 驱动被替换的问题。
- 按目标平台设置发布包入口权限，并在 ZIP 中保留 Unix 权限元数据，修复跨平台打包后可执行权限不正确的问题。
- 更新 QUIC／TLS 传输、ZIP 归档及证书验证相关依赖，纳入对应安全修复。

### 构建与发布

- 发布原生安装包及多架构服务端／代理 Docker 镜像，并对服务端镜像执行数据库迁移和运行验证；隔离并行构建产物与镜像摘要，防止发布时混用。
- 整合 CI、Release 和维护流程，复用准确提交 SHA 对应的完整验证结果；构建可并行提前启动，发布仍须等待验证及所有构建通过。优化 Rust 工具链／锁文件缓存、平台检查和 macOS 交叉编译，并使用预编译 SBOM 工具减少重复安装。
- 为 Docker 依赖安装设置超时并复用已安装工具；CI 和 Release 的 PostgreSQL 镜像拉取最多尝试 4 次，失败后依次等待 10／20／40 秒，步骤总时限 5 分钟。耗尽后保留错误并失败，仅拉取重试，不重复数据库启动、迁移或验证。
- 发布后从 main 更新站点下载清单，确保网站及时展示新版本产物。

### 升级注意

- **仅针对旧 CN 路由记录：** 如果从 beta.28 之前启用过 CN 路由的版本升级，且仍保留缺少 `scoped` 字段的旧 `cn-routes.json`，应在维护窗口使用旧版本正常停用并清理其受管路由后再升级。新版本不兼容该旧记录格式；不可直接删除仍管理活动路由的 journal。没有这类旧记录的安装不需要此步骤。
- 使用旧式内联规则的 sing-box 运行配置需重启核心一次，以启用文件规则集自动重载。免重启更新限于当前运行的 sing-box 所用既有规则集的域名内容；规则集数量、身份、名称、模式或顺序变化仍需重启核心。
- sing-box 公开订阅路径使用完整版本与目标平台，例如 `sing-box/1.13/openwrt`。若客户端保存了旧公开订阅地址或 sing-box 简称路径，请从订阅管理界面重新复制对应版本与平台的链接并更新客户端；原订阅 token 保留。多用户服务端升级仍需按部署流程运行 `sempre-server migrate`。
- [查看 v2.0.19 至 v2.0.20 的完整变更](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v2.0.19...v2.0.20)。

## English

This stable release consolidates the changes since v2.0.19 across the v2.0.20-beta.1 through beta.41 development cycle and subsequent release fixes, describing the final behavior rather than intermediate beta implementations.

### DNS, routing, and traffic interception

- Separate DNS frontend domain policy from CN IP routing. The DNS frontend applies custom domains, built-in domains-min, then the default policy to choose real IP or FakeIP responses. CN routing acts on real destination IPs and no longer forces FakeIP off.
- Add enable, direct/proxy, and core outbound selection for the built-in Mainland China domain set. CN routing can send real mainland IP traffic through the physical uplink or a selected core proxy. Its core rules match only real-IP traffic received through TUN, preventing domestic CDN answers for foreign domains from overriding FakeIP domain policy.
- Fix domains-min disappearing after custom-domain hot updates. Existing custom sing-box domain rule sets support adding, removing, clearing, and restoring domains without restarting the core; new connections use the updated rules while established connections continue running. Roll back failed rule-file publication.
- Add configurable intranet routing, enabled with direct routing by default, with a proxy option. Explicit private-tunnel rules take priority. Direct intranet routing supports sing-box, mihomo, and clash-rs; intranet proxy interception requires sing-box, or mihomo on Linux.
- Adapt recommended FakeIP ranges to host routes, preferring free space within `198.18.0.0/15` before private fallback ranges. Custom DNS settings show conflicts and offer one-click suggestions. Range changes prompt for a restart, with the core, DNS frontend, and transparent proxy using consistent ranges.
- Fix Windows mistaking its own TUN routes for FakeIP conflicts. Retain valid compiled ranges to prevent repeated range changes and restart prompts while continuing to avoid genuine external conflicts.
- Fix CN routing on macOS without an IPv6 default route and provide scoped physical default routes for connections bound to the uplink. Route reuse, ownership, and cleanup include scope, and cleanup removes only matching routes owned by Sempre.
- Use native Windows interface, route, and DNS queries for network information and CN route management. Identify TUN interfaces by IP address, reducing dependence on command output and interface names.
- Make core outbound selection searchable across direct access, available nodes, routable endpoints, and valid groups, and verify the core's actual selection. Clarify direct/proxy labels and distinguish DNS frontend direct routing from core direct routing.

### Core lifecycle and diagnostics

- Remove automatic core check/test, DNS readiness, and static-conflict activation gates from startup, core switching, configuration application, imports, hot updates, and component deployment. Retain manual Validate, actual configuration parsing, and resource ownership checks, and report real core and system-operation errors.
- DNS probe failures, predicted port conflicts, and network-mode combinations no longer preemptively block a running core or trigger configuration rollback. Record actual peripheral-operation failures separately. Remove core DNS health indicators without supporting probes while retaining DNS frontend status and errors.
- Bound core start, stop, and restart stages with timeouts and visible progress. Fix tracking of the startup task after a restart so the UI does not remain indefinitely on one stage.
- Unify startup logs for automatic startup, manual startup, and restart, and stream raw core logs into node diagnostics. Fix a blank page when opening the full configuration from the header startup log.
- Add the host routing table with sorting across the complete paginated data set. Add address autocomplete and common diagnostic presets, including connectivity, HTTP status, and latency checks for 1.1.1.1.
- Separate rule previews from measured request traces, progressively presenting DNS, TCP, TLS, and HTTP results and timings. Show core connection evidence only when uniquely correlated with the request; missing or ambiguous evidence remains unknown rather than being reported as measured direct access.
- Improve full-width diagnostic layouts, step progress, follow behavior, and scrolling. Steps that have not run retain a neutral state.

### Tunnels and WireGuard

- Support WS and WSS tunnel endpoints, defaulting new instances to WSS with certificate verification. Preserve addresses and ports when saving, reopening, or switching protocols, including connections to OpenWrt WS servers.
- Edit one tunnel instance at a time in its own configuration dialog, avoiding changes to unrelated instances.
- Fix WireGuard tunnel bindings not taking effect. Compilation and previews use the selected tunnel's local listener while preserving the original peer and keys; removing the binding restores the original peer. Hide unnecessary direct-UDP peer fields while a tunnel is selected, and restore and validate the original input when switching back.
- Report invalid bindings, ambiguous peers, and unsupported configurations explicitly; stopping a tunnel does not silently fall back to direct UDP. Fix Windows local wstunnel forwarding inheriting the core's default outbound interface binding and failing to send UDP to loopback.

### Subscription editing, conversion, and OpenWrt

- Add graphical rule-source editing grouped by outbound, including group management, names, URLs, types, and formats. Preserve ordering, comments, and fields when renaming. Use selectable, select-all, drag-sortable node tables consistently in client and server editors.
- Keep structured private-access forms and WireGuard import while removing whole-document JSONC editing. Use confirmation dialogs for DNS rewrites and preserve failed-save input; move gateway configuration into a dedicated dialog and remove redundant page actions.
- Fix DNS and domain edits being lost on navigation, existing subscription settings being overwritten during editor migration, unrelated saves rewriting raw sources, and simple mode changing the active subscription. Persist simple/advanced display mode on the instance.
- Add dedicated Claude rules and a proxy group, prioritize Claude and AI defaults, and preserve suffix matching when converting Clash `+.` domain rules.
- Preserve custom DNS upstream protocols, ports, and TLS settings in OpenWrt exports, and align target-specific recommended previews with exported configurations. Preserve IPv4-only FakeIP for OpenWrt sing-box and add direct BitTorrent routing.
- Standardize public subscription links and filter the link dialog by formats such as Clash, sing-box, Xray, V2Ray, and Dae, combined with Windows, macOS, OpenWrt, or generic platforms. Clarify source cache durations and improve editor tabs, navigation order, and dialogs.

### Multi-user server, proxies, and resource relay

- Add managed subscription proxies through imported nodes, manual configuration, or custom-node bindings. The main server remains core-free; the optional separate `sempre-proxy` service supplies managed egress without making the main server take over host TUN, DNS, or system proxy settings.
- Let authenticated users list a credential-free proxy catalog and use or test proxies, while only owners can read or edit their configurations. Encrypt stored configurations and protect referenced proxies from deletion. Proxy-node configuration edits retain explicit Save and Cancel actions.
- Fetch subscription URL sources through the explicitly selected proxy, or directly when none is selected. Direct sources do not inherit environment proxies or the global resource policy; an unavailable selected proxy fails without silently falling back to direct access.
- Add an administrator-managed global resource egress policy with a default outbound, host rules, and saved-policy URL probes. Apply it consistently to rule snapshots, relay requests, rule conversion, mainland IP/domain lists, and the APNIC fallback, separately from subscription URL source choices.
- Centralize remote rule-resource URL wrapping across custom configurations, generated providers, public downloads, and debug output. Forward original binary resources and preserve native sing-box JSON and `.srs` formats without repeated wrapping.
- Partition rule caches, network-list caches, and subscription artifact fallback by egress policy and proxy revisions to prevent reuse of results from an old policy. Remove local public-IP prechecks and DNS pinning from resource relay requests and use the selected outbound's actual networking behavior.

### Upgrades, packaging, and security

- Fix startup failures caused by migration checksum changes in early betas, accepting only verified equivalent historical checksums. Preserve applied migration records when saving traffic history and freeze published migration sources to protect upgrade history.
- Report Windows service readiness after data initialization and listener binding. Verify Web health before committing an update, and stop the new service and roll back the program and UI on failure. Further fix replacement of unchanged shared DNS drivers during updates and restoration.
- Set release entrypoint permissions for the target platform and preserve Unix permission metadata in ZIP archives, fixing incorrect executable permissions after cross-platform packaging.
- Update QUIC/TLS transport, ZIP archive, and certificate-verification dependencies to include their security fixes.

### Builds and releases

- Publish native packages and multi-architecture server/proxy Docker images, with database migrations and runtime verification for the server image. Isolate parallel build artifacts and image digests to prevent publication mix-ups.
- Consolidate CI, Release, and maintenance workflows and reuse complete validation for the exact commit SHA. Start builds in parallel while still requiring validation and every build to pass before publication. Improve Rust toolchain/lockfile caches, platform checks, and macOS cross-compilation, and use a prebuilt SBOM tool to reduce repeated installation.
- Bound Docker dependency installation and reuse installed tools. In CI and Release, attempt PostgreSQL image pulls up to four times with 10/20/40-second delays and a five-minute step limit. Exhausted retries preserve the error and fail; only pulling is retried, not database startup, migrations, or verification.
- Refresh the website's download manifests from main after releases so newly published artifacts appear on the site.

### Upgrade notes

- **Only for old CN route journals:** if upgrading from a version before beta.28 that used CN routing and an old `cn-routes.json` without the `scoped` field remains, use the old version to stop and clean up its managed routes normally during a maintenance window before upgrading. The new version does not accept that journal format. Do not directly delete a journal that still manages active routes. Installations without such an old journal do not need this step.
- Restart sing-box once if its running configuration still uses old inline rules, enabling automatic reload of file-based rule sets. Restart-free updates apply only to domain contents in existing sets used by the currently running sing-box instance; changes to set count, identity, names, modes, or order still require a core restart.
- Public sing-box subscription paths include the full version and target platform, such as `sing-box/1.13/openwrt`. Clients retaining old public subscription URLs or abbreviated sing-box paths should copy the matching version/platform link from subscription management and update their client settings; existing subscription tokens are retained. Multi-user server upgrades still require the normal `sempre-server migrate` deployment step.
- [View all changes from v2.0.19 to v2.0.20](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v2.0.19...v2.0.20).
